page_title: GIR 2-0 OSA | Girona v Osasuna 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) has received a yellow card for his foul.
90+3' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) commits a foul and Mateo Busquets Ferrer immediately signals a free kick.
90+3' Osasuna have a corner.
90+2' The ball is out of play. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+1' Michel decides to make a substitution. Savio will be replaced by Pablo Torre (Girona).
90+1' Substitution. Antonino Jastin (Girona) replaces Ivan Martin.

90+1' Yan Couto (Girona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Girona win a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) has come on for Jesus Areso.
86' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Aleix Garcia feeds Savio (Girona) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.

84' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Paulo Gazzaniga makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
83' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
82' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) makes a strong challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul. Girona have a free kick.
80' Here is a change. Artem Dovbyk is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) is coming onto the pitch as Portu cannot continue after picking up an injury.

79' Yan Couto (Girona) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Sergio Herrera, who tips the ball around the post.
76' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
76' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Portu (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.

73' David Lopez (Girona) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
72' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) picked up a yellow card from referee.
71' The attendance is 11598.

71' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Free kick. Girona will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
70' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) replaces Lucas Torro.
70' A substitution has been made. Ruben Garcia goes off and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes on.
68' The main referee, Mateo Busquets Ferrer, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Portu (Girona) is given a yellow card for dissent.
68' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Girona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
67' Yan Couto (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
64' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
64' Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
64' A substitution has been made. Viktor Tsygankov is replaced by Yan Couto (Girona).
63' Aleix Garcia (Girona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Girona.
62' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
61' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
60' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
59' Daley Blind (Girona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Girona earn a corner.
59' Eric Garcia (Girona) sees a yellow card from Mateo Busquets Ferrer after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
57' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle after Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Girona have a free kick.
56' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
53' A cross by Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
50' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is penalised for holding. Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals a set piece. Girona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
49' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
49' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
48' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
46' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
45+2' A lofted cross from Jesus Areso (Osasuna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows the yellow card to Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) for a heavy challenge.
44' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
43' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Girona.
41' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
41' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
39' An attempted cross from Portu (Girona) is cleared.
37' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Eric Garcia (Girona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Osasuna earn a free kick.
35' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Ivan Martin (Girona) for a tough tackle.
34' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
33' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Girona are awarded the free kick.

31' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Girona, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
29' That was close. Johan Mojica (Osasuna) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
29' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle and it's Artem Dovbyk (Girona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Osasuna.
27' The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
22' A cross into the box from Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) is cleared.
20' The Girona players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
16' A pass lands at the feet of Eric Garcia (Girona) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
15' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Girona was in an offside position.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Viktor Tsygankov plays a simple square pass into the feet of Portu (Girona) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
12' A player from Osasuna commits a rough challenge. Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. There is a free kick near the sideline to Girona.
11' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Osasuna.

10' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Artem Dovbyk (Girona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
6' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
6' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Sergio Herrera makes a comfortable save.
2' Osasuna are ruled offside.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer will referee today's match.
